summary: Bosnia and Herzegovina's only group data on child harm are for trafficking: the Ministry of Security's bulletin reports the ethnicity (Bosniak, Serb, other) and citizenship of victims in court cases monitored by the OSCE Mission, all ages together. The two entity statistics offices publish offenders by offence, sex and age only.
european_title: Bosniaks and Serbs are identified for trafficking victims; ethnic Europeans as a whole are not a category
european_note: The trafficking bulletin names Bosniaks and Serbs and groups everyone else (including Croats) as 'other', with a quarter unknown. No source defines an ethnic European category.

harms.label: Trafficking in human beings
harms.intro: The Ministry of Security registered 65 potential trafficking victims in 2025, 50 of them children, and 19 in January-June 2026 (13 minors; 17 BiH citizens and 2 foreign). Its bulletin also reports the OSCE Mission's monitoring of 31 trafficking-related court cases: 157 victims, of whom 85 were Bosniaks, 15 Serbs, 19 other and 38 of unknown ethnicity, with 59 defendants (no ethnicity given). Victims are not split by age.

victims.scope: Bosnia and Herzegovina, victims in trafficking-related court cases monitored by the OSCE Mission (all ages), January-June 2026
victims.share_note: Ministry of Security, Biannual Bulletin January-June 2026, OSCE trial-monitoring section: 157 victims (29 men, 128 women) in 31 monitored cases; 85 Bosniaks, 15 Serbs, 19 other ethnic groups (Croats are not named separately), 38 unknown. This is real ethnicity data, recorded in the case files the OSCE monitors, not citizenship. The cases cover trafficking, enticement to prostitution, child pornography and child neglect charges; victims are not split by age.

perpetrators.text: The 59 defendants in monitored cases are given by sex only.

components.name: Victim heritage
components.full: Official data by harm that separately identify ethnic European children (e.g. White non-Hispanic, White British) alongside every other group, self-reported or official, few unknowns. Broad categories that lump ethnic Europeans with others get partial credit; proxies (nationality, citizenship, migration background, country of birth) at most 9.4 points.

components.name: Perpetrator heritage
components.full: Same standard for perpetrators: not perceived, few unknowns, ethnic Europeans separately identified. Proxies at most 9.4 points.

components.name: Coverage and missing data
components.full: Over 90% of the population covered, under 10% unknown

components.name: Rates and linkage
components.full: Rates per 100,000 possible, and victim heritage linked to perpetrator heritage

score.gold_standard: 100% means a country publishes data that separately identifies ethnic Europeans, both as perpetrators (so one can tell when they disproportionately harm a group) and as child victims (so one can tell when ethnic European children are disproportionately harmed), alongside every other group, linked victim to perpetrator, for every harm.
score.rules: Heritage is 75 of every 100 points (victims 37.5, perpetrators 37.5); coverage, rates and access share the other 25. Proxies such as nationality or migration background earn at most a quarter of the heritage points. A country with no real ethnicity data for victims or perpetrators is capped at 25%.
score.why: Bosnia and Herzegovina scores 9% on the stricter scale (0-20%). The only group data are for trafficking: the Ministry of Security's bulletin gives the ethnicity (Bosniak, Serb, other) and citizenship of victims in OSCE-monitored trafficking cases, so the cap does not apply. The entity statistics offices publish no ethnicity or citizenship for any other harm.
score.weights_id: harm weights of 19 Nov 2026 (homicide 25, sexual abuse 20, sex trafficking 20, physical abuse 15, online exploitation 10, neglect 10)

msb.name: Biannual Bulletin on trafficking in human beings, January-June 2026
msb.publisher: Ministry of Security of Bosnia and Herzegovina (State Coordinator for Combating Trafficking)
msb.records: Potential and identified victims by age, sex and citizenship; OSCE Mission trial-monitoring data with victims by sex, ethnicity and citizenship.
msb.limitations: Six months only; the monitored-case victims are not split by age; defendants have no ethnicity. The detailed statistics portal requires a login.

fzs.name: Statistika pravosuđa 2025 (statistical bulletin 423)
fzs.publisher: Federalni zavod za statistiku (Institute for Statistics of FBiH)

availability_note: Each harm has an 'availability' map listing the victim and perpetrator groups with any published figure (overall and by measure) and any linked victim-perpetrator pairs. Groups not listed have no data for that harm; the explorer should grey them out rather than offer an empty combination.
